name: Transformer restricted-earth-fault zone interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Defines the current measurement boundary used by the assigned restricted-earth-fault scheme.
description: Defines the current measurement boundary used by the assigned restricted-earth-fault scheme. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Phase and neutral currents” at the input and “REF protection-zone information” at the output. CT placement and polarity determine the protected boundary.
